note: Calibrated from a real Vital standalone GUI capture (Init Preset). Coords are in the reference_size pixel space; load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Vital draws a WHITE pointer line over a teal fill-arc; pointer="white" reads the colourless pointer (bright + low-saturation) and ignores the arc, so absolute values are accurate (full SUSTAIN reads ~1.0). Extend by adding controls.
_controls_note: OSC 1 knobs (level/pan/unison/phase) calibrated from the Init Preset (OSC 1 enabled). The white-pointer reader records each knob's normalized POSITION [0,1] — the synth-specific position→display mapping (e.g. unison position 0.5 shows '20%') is non-linear, but recording position is reproduction-correct: re-setting the same position reproduces the patch. Vital's filter CUTOFF/RESONANCE are GRAPH-DRAG controls (X/Y on the response graph), NOT knobs, so the white-pointer reader can't read them — those are graphic params for §8. The filter module's only knobs are DRIVE/MIX/KEY-TRK (dim unless the filter is enabled).
